deepseek_judge.note: M.4 'DeepSeek LLM judge'; deepseek-ai chat models on a DeepSeek base that fit an A100 80GB in bf16

gemma_judge.note: Google LLM judge (2026-10-08): the latest Gemma generation that transformers 5.16.1 supports natively and that fits an A100 80GB in bf16 (Gemma 4); one model, the same prompt and adapter as the DeepSeek judges, its own chat template
gemma_judge.selection: Gemma 4 instruction-tuned checkpoints: E2B, E4B, 12B (dense, encoder-free), 26B-A4B (mixture of experts), 31B (dense). Taken: the largest one that runs under the judges' approved settings unchanged (bf16, eager, fixed batch [8, 4096]) and whose score cannot depend on its batch neighbours by construction (II.10): 31B exceeds 80 GB at that shape (about 58 GiB weights + 24 GiB eager attention), 26B-A4B routes tokens to experts, so the per-expert matrix shapes change with the batch content; 12B remains. Chosen before any score.
